T0543.title: Object Storage Bucket
T0543.definition: A logical container in cloud object storage used to hold files, snapshots, logs, and other unstructured data.
T0543.description: Object storage buckets often hold uploads, backups, logs, model data, and business exports. Public access mistakes, cross-tenant path design flaws, or poorly managed signed URLs can cause large-scale data exposure. Controls focus on private defaults, bucket-policy review, object-level permissions, sensitive-data scanning, and link expiration.
T0543.usageExample: Assess Object Storage Bucket related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
